name: 92069 · San Marcos, CA
findings: ZIP 92069 (San Marcos) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92069 (San Marcos) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92069 (San Marcos) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
